mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 83 degrees, which feels like 92 at Firemans Park. The moon phase is a waning crescent.
The City Clerk has wrapped up the I Voted sticker contest for local students, and the city plan commission is currently reviewing site plans for 201 South Main Street.

There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Macs, followed by the Downtown Farmers Market and live music later this week.
On August 8, officers assisted the Dane County Sheriffs Office with a rollover crash where the driver fled the scene, but was later arrested for O W I.
Make sure to satisfy your sweet tooth today with a scoop of Georgia Peach at Culvers, which remains open until 10 PM tonight.
